additional_info.subject: ID0386609-DC/Si-D/ES-[lYHzTl]- Cable Temperature error CRM:00645000829
additional_info.body:
Dear Customer,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Vishal
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / ND 170000060
ChargerID/Serial No.
: lYHzTl
Problem Description
: Cable Temperature error
We have analyzed the logs and found that the charging session stopped at 39% due to a cable temperature error.
This error indicates that the temperature difference between the DC+ and DC- contacts is too high. We recommend checking the cable temperature sensors. Please refer to the snapshot below:
Check the resistance of both sensors at terminal XD14:
For the DC+ sensor: measure between B5 and B7
For the DC- sensor: measure between D6 and D8
Connections to check:
PT1000 Resistance Table for reference:
If the measured values are significantly high or incorrect, the cable temperature sensors may be defective, potentially requiring a complete cable replacement.
Additionally, upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty. Please note that we can provide only 1 hour of remote support for out-of-warranty charger cases. If you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to
Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Please let us know if you have any further queries or we will move this case to your queue for further actions.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0386609
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vishal Dhiman
